premises.text: Immigrants face significant barriers and costs when sending money home
premises.evidence_span: they have to pay for a bus to go to an agency wait online for two hours and go to another agency to pay their utility bills on top of that Western Union taxes them up to 10%

premises.text: Regali allows immigrants to send money directly to their family's cell phone
premises.evidence_span: hard-working immigrants can send a credit directly to their family's cell phone in Latin America

premises.text: The service can be used for essential needs like food, medicine, and utility bills
premises.evidence_span: that could be used to pay for food medicine utility bills even tuition

premises.text: Customers can access the service both online and offline through partner stores
premises.evidence_span: our customers can visit us online or can visit us offline our one of 200 partner mom-and-pop stores

premises.text: The remittance process is instant and user-friendly
premises.evidence_span: she gets an instant SMS notification

premises.text: The service has a viral component allowing fund transfers between family members
premises.evidence_span: her sister also has the option to transfer part of those funds to a family member or another friend

premises.text: Regali has a significant growth rate and customer base
premises.evidence_span: we are growing 67% week over week have over 5,000 customers and just last week alone we had 1200 new paying customers

premises.text: Regali has contracts with a large number of retail locations for service access
premises.evidence_span: we already have the contracts that gives us access to 7200 retail locations in eight different countries

premises.text: The service offers a low flat fee that is significantly cheaper than alternatives
premises.evidence_span: a low flat fee of just three dollars up to 70% cheaper than any alternative

premises.text: There is a large revenue opportunity from the immigrant remittance market
premises.evidence_span: multiply that by the 40 million immigrants who send money back home every single month and you have a three point four billion dollar revenue opportunity

value.text: Immigrants can support their families' basic needs more easily and affordably
value.evidence_span: helping 40 million immigrants put food on the table I keep in the lights on with a loved one

notes: Traction metrics and personal anecdotes are included as premises.
